pokedexEntries.rb: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

pokedexEntries.ye: If you touch the feeler on top of its head, it will release a horrible stink to protect itself.

pokedexEntries.go: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

pokedexEntries.si: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

pokedexEntries.cr: It crawls into foliage where it camouflages itself among leaves that are the same color as its body.

pokedexEntries.rs: CATERPIE has a voracious appetite. It can devour leaves bigger than its body right before your eyes. From its antenna, this POKéMON releases a terrifically strong odor.

pokedexEntries.fr: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

pokedexEntries.lg: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

pokedexEntries.em: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.

pokedexEntries.hg: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

pokedexEntries.su: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

pokedexEntries.mo: It’s easy to catch, and it grows quickly, making it one of the top recommendations for novice Pokémon Trainers.

pokedexEntries.us: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

pokedexEntries.um: Its body is soft and weak. In nature, its perpetual fate is to be seen by others as food.
